home.title: Caresse — Multitherapeutic Services
home.description: Multitherapeutic services empowering children, teens, and adults to express, develop, and thrive with confidence.

book.title: Book a Session — Caresse
book.description: Request a consultation session with Caresse's multitherapeutic team. We'll contact you to find the right specialist for your family.

team.title: Our Team — Caresse
team.description: Meet Caresse's multitherapeutic team: speech-language, feeding, ABA and occupational therapists supporting children and families.

autism.title: Autism
autism.description: Personalized therapy plans tailored to each case based on the child's unique condition, strengths, and developmental needs.

speechLanguage.title: Speech & Language Disorders
speechLanguage.description: Comprehensive assessment and targeted intervention for speech delays, articulation difficulties, and language development challenges.

neuroDevelopmental.title: Neuro Developmental Disorder
neuroDevelopmental.description: Specialized rehabilitation and support for cerebral palsy and other neurological conditions affecting motor and cognitive development.

feeding.title: Feeding Disorders
feeding.description: Expert evaluation and therapy for children experiencing feeding difficulties, oral motor challenges, and food aversions.

familySupport.title: Family Support
familySupport.description: Empowering parents and caregivers with guidance, strategies, and resources to create a nurturing and supportive home environment.

coTherapy.title: Co-Therapy
coTherapy.description: Collaborative, multidisciplinary therapy sessions combining specialists to deliver integrated and holistic treatment plans.

personalized.title: Personalized Treatment Plans
personalized.description: Every person's journey is unique. We tailor our clinical therapy programs directly to individual needs, goals, and speeds.

certified.title: Certified & Caring Therapists
certified.description: Our licensed multidisciplinary team operates with a deep commitment to gentle, effective, evidence-based practices.

childFriendly.title: Child-Friendly Environment
childFriendly.description: Our state-of-the-art sensory rooms and treatment spaces are designed to feel bright, playful, and completely safe.

familyCentered.title: Family-Centered Approach
familyCentered.description: We work closely alongside parents and school teams, ensuring progress is supported outside the clinic walls too.

Delivery.title: How We Reach You
Delivery.subtitle: Choose the way that works best for you - from the comfort of home to our welcoming clinic, or from anywhere via secure online sessions.

home.title: Home Visits
home.description: We come to you. Our therapists provide personalized sessions in the comfort of your home.

clinic.title: At the Clinic
clinic.description: Visit us at our center for a fully equipped, welcoming therapy environment.

online.title: Online Sessions
online.description: Connect with our specialists remotely through secure, convenient virtual sessions.

Shop.title: Our Therapy Shop
Shop.subtitle: Explore the materials and tools our therapists use - now available for home practice
